verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a root llms.txt (HTTP 200) that Meilisearch says it maintains to help AI assistants. They also confirm markdown versions of the docs pages, which point agents to a full documentation index at /docs/llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed at either. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use these files effectively, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other expanded agent-specific guidance.
